integrity: Claims follow analytic arguments; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: A complete trichotomy only for the specified power-law two-by-two Jordan-block direct sum; no general nonnormal-semigroup classification or equality of pseudospectra. Older Lee–Morales full text was inaccessible; priority remains conditional on further bibliography.
title: Identical spectral data and a sharp expansiveness transition for two-scale Jordan semigroups
